policy.dilrmp3FederatedCustody: The DILRMP 3.0 framework uses secure API-based interoperability while each State/UT or concerned department retains ownership and custody of its records.
policy.uliAccess: The RBIH/ULI LRS is a credentialed institutional service for supported States; do not treat it as an open bulk download source.
policy.thirdPartyProviderUse: Individual on-demand lookups only under the provider terms. Do not bulk-scrape, bulk-export, redistribute/resell, build a competing database, or use for model training/evaluation without written licence.
policy.thirdPartyRecordsNotGovernmentCertified: Third-party aggregator results are not official government responses, certified copies or title adjudications. Display their underlying source and read date when provided.
